title: Senior Structural Engineer (PEB)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
DEC Industries was founded in 1968 as a flagship company of the DEC Group. For over 50 years, we have been a pioneer in industrial infrastructure, manufacturing world-class solutions that shape skylines and industrial capabilities across India. We span decades of innovation, relying on three simple ideas: Leadership, Innovation, and Citizenship.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Structural Engineer specializing in Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) to lead the design, analysis, and execution of industrial and commercial steel structures. The role involves structural design of PEB systems including primary frames, secondary members, connections, and foundations. You will work on projects that define the industrial landscape of Telangana and beyond.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Lead PEB structural design using STAAD.Pro, MBS, and ETABS software.
- Perform detailed load calculations (Dead, Live, Wind, Seismic) strictly adhering to IS 800:2007 and AISC standards.
- Develop General Arrangement (GA) drawings and structural calculation reports for client approval.
- Review and approve Tekla detailing models to ensure design intent is accurately translated to fabrication.
- Optimize steel weight to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising structural safety.
- Coordinate with architects, consultants, and clients for technical approvals and design changes.
- Provide technical support to site erection teams during critical lifting and installation phases.

WHAT WE OFFER:
- We guarantee you responsibilities from Day 1, managing critical infrastructure projects.
- Ownership of design decisions for high-value industrial assets.
- Continuous training on the latest software (MBS, Tekla) and international design codes.
- Competitive compensation package with performance-based bonuses.
- Comprehensive health insurance for you and your immediate family.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
- B.E / B.Tech / M.Tech in Civil or Structural Engineering.
- 8–15 years of dedicated experience in Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) design.
- Strong command of IS 800, MBMA, and AISC codes.
- Proficiency in STAAD.Pro, MBS, ETABS, and AutoCAD is mandatory.
- Professional License (Chartered Engineer) is a significant plus.
minimumQualification: B.E / B.Tech / M.Tech in Civil or Structural Engineering.

title: Senior Tekla Modeler
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
At DEC Industries, accuracy is our hallmark. Our Engineering department is the backbone of our 500-acre manufacturing capability. We believe in getting it right the first time.

We are looking for a Senior Tekla Modeler who can bridge the gap between design and reality. You will be responsible for creating highly accurate 3D BIM models and fabrication drawings that our factory uses to produce thousands of tons of steel. Your work directly impacts the speed and quality of our construction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Generate comprehensive 3D models for PEB structures and hot-rolled steel sections using Tekla Structures.
- Produce shop drawings, erection drawings, and Bill of Materials (BOM) for production.
- Identify and resolve clashing issues and complex connection details during the modeling phase.
- Collaborate with the structural design team to ensure constructability of connections.
- Generate NC files for CNC machines and coordinate with the production planning team.
- Mentor junior detailers and ensure drawing standards are maintained.

WHAT WE OFFER:
- Work with a high-performance team using the latest BIM technology.
- Opportunity to work on complex, large-scale industrial projects.
- Technical certification support for advanced Tekla training.
- A stable career path with a 50-year-old industry leader.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
- Diploma or B.Tech in Civil/Mechanical Engineering.
- Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Steel Detailing.
- Certified Tekla Structures Professional preferred.
- Deep understanding of welded and bolted connection details.
- Ability to read and interpret complex structural design drawings.
minimumQualification: Diploma or B.Tech in Civil/Mechanical Engineering.

title: Sales Manager (Govt Projects)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
DEC Industries is a trusted partner for India's infrastructure growth. We work with CPWD, Railways, Defense, and other major government bodies.

The Sales Manager (Govt Projects) will drive business growth by securing large-scale government infrastructure tenders. This role requires a deep understanding of the tendering process, technical specifications, and government liaisoning.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Track and identify relevant government tenders on GeM and CPPP portals.
- Analyze tender documents (RFQ/RFP) and assess eligibility criteria.
- Prepare comprehensive technical and commercial bids for EPC contracts.
- Negotiate pricing and contract terms to maximize profitability.
- Liaison with government officials and departments for order closure and payment follow-ups.
- Build a robust pipeline of upcoming infrastructure projects.

WHAT WE OFFER:
- High sales commission structure on top of base salary.
- Travel and Mobile allowances.
- Direct interaction with high-level government officials and decision-makers.
- Key role in expanding the company’s public sector footprint.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
- MBA in Marketing or B.Tech Civil.
- 6–12 years of experience in Government Tendering and Contracting.
- Expertise in GeM (Government e-Marketplace) and e-tendering portals.
- Strong negotiation and networking skills.
- Fluent in English, Hindi, and Telugu.
minimumQualification: MBA in Marketing or B.Tech Civil.

title: HR Generalist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
People are our greatest asset. The HR team at DEC Industries works to recruit, retain, and develop the best talent in the industry.

The HR Generalist will manage end-to-end HR operations, supporting both the corporate office and the plant. This role covers recruitment, payroll coordination, employee engagement, and statutory compliance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for technical and non-technical roles.
- Process attendance inputs and coordinate with accounts for monthly payroll.
- Handle employee grievances and maintain positive employee relations.
- Ensure statutory compliance with PF, ESI, and Professional Tax authorities.
- Organize employee engagement activities, training programs, and performance appraisals.
- Maintain the HR Management Information System (HRMIS) and employee records.

WHAT WE OFFER:
- Dynamic work environment with exposure to all HR functions.
- Medical Insurance and Gratuity.
- Paid Maternity/Paternity leave.
- Opportunity to shape the company culture.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
- MBA in Human Resources.
- 3-7 years of experience in the Manufacturing or Construction sector.
- Strong knowledge of labor laws and statutory compliance.
- Proficiency in HRMS software and MS Excel.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
